spans.s: पण् vt. or vi. 1Ā (pp. पणित or पणायित; pres. पणाते in the first two senses, and पणायति in the third sense, the root being conjugated, in the Par. in that sense) 1. To deal in, to barter, to bargain, to transact business; 2. to bet or stake at play; (in these senses it is generally used with a gen., प्राणानामपणिष्टासौ Bh.V.iii.121, but sometimes with an acc.); 3. to praise.With वि-, to sell, to barter, आभीरदेशे किल चंद्रकांतं त्रिभिर्वराटैर्विपणंति गोपाः Panch.i.

पण m. 1. A game played for a stake; 2. the thing staked; 3. a stipulation, a treaty; 4. wages, hire; 5. price; 6. a coin equal in value to eighty cowries (अशीतिभिर्वराटकैः पण इत्यभिधीयते); 7. wealth, property; 8. a commodity for sale; 9. a vendor; 10. a shop; 11. a distiller; 12. a house.
पाण m. 1. Trade, traffic; 2. a trader; 3. an agreement, a contract; 4. praise; 5. the hand.
पण-अंगना, -स्त्री f. a prostitute, a harlot.
पण-अंगना, -स्त्री f. a prostitute, a harlot.
पण-ग्रंथि m. a market.
पण-बंध m. 1. making a treaty; 2. an agreement (यदि भवानिदं कुर्यात्तर्हीदमहं भवते दास्यामीति समयकरणं पणबंधः Manoramā).
पणन n. 1. Betting; 2. bartering; 3. sale.
पणव m. A sort of musical instrument, Bg.i.13.
पणाया f. 1. Transaction, business; 2. a marketplace; 3. gambling; 4. praise.
पणि (I) f. A market.
पणि (II) m. A miser, a niggard.
पाणि (I) m. The hand, R.iii.68, xi.31.
पाणि (II) f. A market.
पणित a. (f. ता) 1. Transacted; 2. betted, (pp. of पण् q.v.).
पणित a. (f. ता) 1. Transacted; 2. betted, (pp. of पण् q.v.).
पण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) 1. Saleable, vendible; 2. to be transacted.
पण्य (II) m. 1. A ware, a commodity, पूराबभासे विपणिस्थपण्या R.xvi.41, M.v.129; 2. traffic, business; 3. price, महता पुण्यपण्येन क्रीतेयं कायनौस्त्वया Sant.S.iii.1.
पण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) 1. Saleable, vendible; 2. to be transacted.
पण्य-अंगना, -योषित्, -विलासिनी, -स्त्री f. a harlot, a courtezan, पण्यस्त्रीषु विचेककल्पलतिकाशस्त्रीषु रज्येत कः Bhartr.i.90, Megh.i.25.
